  ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fbaddr.BUILDING_KEY
  AND fbaddr.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS TOTAL_DISTINCT_COURSE_COUNT_PER_DEPARTMENT
  FROM summer_subjects_offered
  GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE
) dept_counts
  ON dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE

rows.question: For each term code, list the term description, attribute desciption, department name, school name, and the number of subjects in the area of humanities, arts and social sciences.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH term_master AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(at.`TERM_CODE`, ata.`TERM_CODE`) AS `TERM_CODE`,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(at.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`, ''), NULLIF(ata.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`, '')) AS `TERM_DESCRIPTION`,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(at.`TERM_START_DATE`, ''), NULLIF(ata.`TERM_START_DATE`, '')) AS `TERM_START_DATE`,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(at.`TERM_END_DATE`, ''), NULLIF(ata.`TERM_END_DATE`, '')) AS `TERM_END_DATE`,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(at.`ACADEMIC_YEAR`, ''), NULLIF(ata.`ACADEMIC_YEAR`, '')) AS `ACADEMIC_YEAR`
  FROM `academic_terms` AS at
  RIGHT JOIN `academic_terms_all` AS ata
    ON at.`TERM_CODE` = ata.`TERM_CODE`
  GROUP BY
    COALESCE(at.`TERM_CODE`, ata.`TERM_CODE`)
),
-- build a subject-level summary (placeholder based on available catalog tables)
subject_summary AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, dcc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, ccc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE) AS TERM_CODE,
    COALESCE(ccs.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, dcc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, ccc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    COALESCE(ccs.SUBJECT_ID, dcc.SUBJECT_ID, ccc.SUBJECT_ID) AS SUBJECT_ID,
    COALESCE(ccs.SUBJECT_CODE, dcc.SUBJECT_CODE, ccc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS SUBJECT_CODE,
    COALESCE(ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE, dcc.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
    COALESCE(ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    -- attempt to derive school name from department (no explicit school table in schema; keep NULL if not available)
    NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered` ccs
  LEFT JOIN `drupal_course_catalog` dcc
    ON ccs.SUBJECT_ID = dcc.SUBJECT_ID AND ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = dcc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
  LEFT JOIN `cis_course_catalog` ccc
    ON ccs.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = ccc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID OR ccs.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID
  UNION
  SELECT
    COALESCE(dcc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, ccc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE) AS TERM_CODE,
    COALESCE(dcc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, ccc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    COALESCE(dcc.SUBJECT_ID, ccc.SUBJECT_ID) AS SUBJECT_ID,
    COALESCE(dcc.SUBJECT_CODE, ccc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS SUBJECT_CODE,
    COALESCE(dcc.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
    COALESCE(dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME
  FROM `drupal_course_catalog` dcc
  LEFT JOIN `cis_course_catalog` ccc
    ON dcc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = ccc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID OR dcc.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID
  UNION
  SELECT
    ccc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
    ccc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    ccc.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
    ccc.SUBJECT_CODE AS SUBJECT_CODE,
    ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
    ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME
  FROM `cis_course_catalog` ccc
),
-- map HASS attributes (we need rows where the CIS attribute group = 'H')
hass_subjects AS (
  SELECT
    ss.TERM_CODE,
    ss.SUBJECT_ID,
    ss.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    ss.SCHOOL_NAME,
    -- attribute description prefer bulletin then form
    COALESCE(ch.DESCRIPTION_IN_BULLETIN, ch.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM) AS HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC
  FROM subject_summary ss
  JOIN `cis_course_catalog` ccc
    ON (ccc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND ccc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = ss.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID)
       OR (ccc.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID)
  JOIN `cis_hass_attribute` ch
    ON ccc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = ch.HASS_ATTRIBUTE
  WHERE ch.CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP = 'H'
    AND ss.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
    AND ss.SUBJECT_ID <> ''
)
SELECT
  tm.TERM_CODE,
  tm.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  hs.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC AS CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP_DESC,
  hs.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  hs.SCHOOL_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT hs.SUBJECT_ID) AS NUM_SUBJECTS_H
FROM term_master tm
LEFT JOIN hass_subjects hs
  ON hs.TERM_CODE = tm.TERM_CODE
GROUP BY
  tm.TERM_CODE,
  tm.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  hs.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
  hs.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  hs.SCHOOL_NAME
ORDER BY tm.TERM_CODE

rows.question: List building names, their height, street address, city, state, postal code, their gross and assignable square footage, the smallest and largest floor level and the total area of all rooms for each building key.

    fr.MINOR_ORGANIZATION,
    fr.AREA,
    fr.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
    fr.DEPT_CODE,
    fr.ACCESS_LEVEL,
    fr.LATITUDE_WGS,
    fr.LONGITUDE_WGS,
    fr.NORTHING_SPCS,
    fr.EASTING_SPCS,
    fr.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
  FROM fac_rooms fr
  LEFT JOIN fac_building fb
    ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN fac_floor ff
    ON fr.FLOOR_KEY = ff.FLOOR_KEY
),
fclt_building_current AS (
  SELECT
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    NULLIF(fb.BUILDING_NUMBER, '') AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
    NULLIF(fb.BUILDING_NAME, '') AS BUILDING_NAME,
    fb.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
  FROM (
    SELECT
      FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
      BUILDING_NUMBER,
      BUILDING_NAME,
      WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY FAC_BUILDING_KEY
        ORDER BY
          CASE WHEN WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE IS NULL OR WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC,
          WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE DESC
      ) AS rn
    FROM fac_building
  ) AS fb
  WHERE fb.rn = 1
),
building_floor_room_areas AS (
  SELECT
    bldg_keys.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    MIN(floors.FLOOR) AS SMALLEST_FLOOR_LEVEL,
    MAX(floors.FLOOR) AS LARGEST_FLOOR_LEVEL,
    SUM(COALESCE(rooms.AREA, 0)) AS TOTAL_ROOMS_AREA
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT BUILDING_KEY FROM fac_rooms_space_area
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY FROM fac_building
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT BUILDING_KEY FROM buildings
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY FROM fclt_building_current
  ) AS bldg_keys
  LEFT JOIN fac_rooms_space_area AS rooms
    ON rooms.BUILDING_KEY = bldg_keys.BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT BUILDING_KEY, FLOOR FROM fac_rooms_space_area WHERE FLOOR IS NOT NULL
  ) AS floors
    ON floors.BUILDING_KEY = bldg_keys.BUILDING_KEY
  GROUP BY bldg_keys.BUILDING_KEY
)
SELECT
  b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  b.BUILDING_HEIGHT,
  CONCAT_WS(' ',
    aba.STREET_NUMBER,

  ) AS STREET_ADDRESS,

  b.EXT_GROSS_AREA AS EXT_GROSS_AREA,
  b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
  bfra.SMALLEST_FLOOR_LEVEL,
  bfra.LARGEST_FLOOR_LEVEL,
  COALESCE(bfra.TOTAL_ROOMS_AREA, 0) AS TOTAL_ROOMS_AREA
FROM fac_building b

rows.question: What is the category title, version, department name, school name, total number of courses for each course level, and the total number of degree-granting courses for each CIP category code?

WITH cip_master AS (
  SELECT
    `PROGRAM_CODE` AS PROGRAM_CODE,
    `PROGRAM_TITLE` AS PROGRAM_TITLE,
    `CATEGORY_CODE` AS CATEGORY_CODE,
    `CATEGORY_TITLE` AS CATEGORY_TITLE,
    `FOUR_DIGIT_CODE` AS FOUR_DIGIT_CODE,
    `FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE` AS FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE,
    `VERSION` AS VERSION
  FROM `cip`
)
SELECT
  cm.PROGRAM_CODE AS cip_code,
  cm.CATEGORY_TITLE AS category_title,
  cm.VERSION AS version,
  scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  scd.SCHOOL_NAME,
  COALESCE(scd.undergrad_count, 0) AS undergraduate_courses,
  COALESCE(scd.grad_count, 0) AS graduate_courses,
  COALESCE(scd.degree_granting_count, 0) AS degree_granting_courses
FROM cip_master cm
JOIN (
  SELECT
    CIP_PROGRAM_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SCHOOL_NAME,
    SUM(CASE WHEN COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS undergrad_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS grad_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS degree_granting_count
  FROM sis_course_description
  GROUP BY CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME
) scd
  ON cm.PROGRAM_CODE = scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE
ORDER BY cm.PROGRAM_CODE

  MAX(

      WHEN lr.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG.CATALOG_YEAR` REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(lr.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG.CATALOG_YEAR` AS SIGNED)

rows.question: What is the material status, term description, total number of courses and materials, occurences in departments and school, and the total number of instructors for each library material status code and term code?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH library_reserve_material_rows AS (
SELECT
  lmd.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`,
  lmd.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`,
  lmd.`LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY`,
  lmd.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`,
  lmd.`TERM_CODE`
FROM
  `library_reserve_matrl_detail` AS lmd
)
SELECT
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE AS material_status_code,
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status_text,
  lrmr.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS term_description,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lrmr.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS total_courses,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_materials,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE SEPARATOR ', ') AS departments_occurrences,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME SEPARATOR ', ') AS schools_occurrences,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME) AS total_instructors
FROM
  library_reserve_material_rows lrmr
LEFT JOIN tip_material_status tms
  ON lrmr.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
LEFT JOIN tip_detail td
  ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrmr.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
LEFT JOIN tip_material tm
  ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
LEFT JOIN library_subject_offered lso
  ON lrmr.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
LEFT JOIN library_course_instructor lci
  ON lrmr.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
LEFT JOIN academic_terms at
  ON lrmr.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
WHERE
  lrmr.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
  AND lrmr.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE,
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS,
  lrmr.TERM_CODE,
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION
ORDER BY
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE,
  lrmr.TERM_CODE

rows.question: For each distinct mailing list containing more than 1000 people and with a name starting with A (case insensitive), provide its name, whether it is a mailing list, whether it is a moira group, whether it is a NFS group, the owner of the mailing list, and the number of people in the list.

SELECT

       WHEN LOWER(ml.`HASS_ATTRIBUTE`) = 'nfs' THEN TRUE

rows.question: List the mailing lists with the largest number of members and the least number of members, including their names, owners, public status, hidden status, and number of members in the list. If a mailing list has multiple owners, create a separate entry for each owner. Similarly, if multiple lists share the minimum or maximum member count, include all those lists.

WITH moira_list_row AS (
  SELECT
    `MOIRA_LIST_KEY`,
    `MOIRA_LIST_NAME`,
    `IS_PUBLIC`,
    `IS_HIDDEN`
  FROM `moira_list`
),
moira_list_member_counts AS (
  SELECT
    `MOIRA_LIST_KEY`,
    COUNT(*) AS member_count
  FROM `moira_list_detail`
  GROUP BY `MOIRA_LIST_KEY`
),
moira_list_owners AS (
  SELECT
    `MOIRA_LIST_KEY`,
    `OWNER`
  FROM `moira_list_owner`
),
min_max_counts AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(member_count) AS max_count,
    MIN(member_count) AS min_count
  FROM (
    SELECT mlr.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`, COALESCE(mlmc.member_count, 0) AS member_count
    FROM moira_list_row mlr
    LEFT JOIN moira_list_member_counts mlmc
      ON mlr.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` = mlmc.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`
  ) AS t
)
SELECT
  mlr.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`,
  mlr.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME`,
  mlo.`OWNER`,
  mlr.`IS_PUBLIC`,
  mlr.`IS_HIDDEN`,
  COALESCE(mlmc.member_count, 0) AS member_count
FROM moira_list_row mlr
LEFT JOIN moira_list_member_counts mlmc
  ON mlr.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` = mlmc.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`
LEFT JOIN moira_list_owners mlo
  ON mlr.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` = mlo.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`
JOIN min_max_counts mm
  ON COALESCE(mlmc.member_count, 0) IN (mm.max_count, mm.min_count)
ORDER BY member_count DESC, mlr.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME`, mlo.`OWNER`

      WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, ''), '') <> ''
        THEN CONCAT('MITID::', fst.INSTRUCTOR_MIT_ID)
      WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, ''), '') = ''
        AND fst.INSTRUCTOR_NAME IS NOT NULL AND fst.INSTRUCTOR_NAME <> ''
        AND TRIM(COALESCE(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, '')) = fst.INSTRUCTOR_NAME
        THEN CONCAT('NAME::', fst.INSTRUCTOR_NAME)
      ELSE NULL
    END
  ) AS faculty_in_list_with_summer_after_2001
FROM moira_list ml
JOIN moira_list_detail mld
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
    -- only lists whose name starts with 'C' (case-insensitive)
    AND ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME REGEXP '^[cC]'
LEFT JOIN faculty_summer_teaching_terms fst
  ON (
       -- match by MIT ID when available
       COALESCE(NULLIF(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, ''), '') <> ''
       AND mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID = fst.INSTRUCTOR_MIT_ID
     )
  OR (
       -- otherwise match by exact full name (trimmed)
       COALESCE(NULLIF(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, ''), '') = ''
       AND TRIM(COALESCE(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, '')) = fst.INSTRUCTOR_NAME
     )
GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
ORDER BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME

rows.question: Regarding the mailing list about duo users, provide the number of students in this list, and the number of departments and schools associated with these students.

WITH subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject AS (

    MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT,

),
employee_directory_contact_normalized AS (
  SELECT
    MIT_ID,

    FIRST_NAME,
    MIDDLE_NAME,
    FULL_NAME,
    DIRECTORY_FULL_NAME,
    OFFICE_LOCATION,
    OFFICE_PHONE,

    PRIMARY_TITLE,
    DEPARTMENT_NUMBER,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    KRB_NAME,
    KRB_NAME_UPPERCASE,
    EMAIL_ADDRESS,
    PERSONAL_URL,
    NAME_KNOWN_BY,
    EMAIL_ADDRESS_UPPERCASE,
    FULL_NAME_UPPERCASE,
    COALESCE(PREFERRED_FIRST_NAME, FIRST_NAME) AS PREFERRED_FIRST_NAME,
    COALESCE(PREFERRED_LAST_NAME, LAST_NAME) AS PREFERRED_LAST_NAME,
    COALESCE(PREFERRED_MIDDLE_NAME, MIDDLE_NAME) AS PREFERRED_MIDDLE_NAME
  FROM employee_directory
),
-- choose latest mapping per department/school to join against employee directory department number
dept_school_latest AS (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SCHOOL_CODE,
    SCHOOL_NAME,
    MAX(last_warehouse_load_date) AS last_warehouse_load_date
  FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_CODE, SCHOOL_NAME
),
-- build student-like rows by connecting employee_directory entries to department/school info when possible
students_with_department_school AS (
  SELECT
    edc.FULL_NAME AS student_identifier,
    edc.MIT_ID AS mit_id,
    COALESCE(ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, edc.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER) AS department_code,
    COALESCE(ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS department_name,
    ss.SCHOOL_CODE AS school_code,
    ss.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name
  FROM employee_directory_contact_normalized edc
  LEFT JOIN subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject ss
    ON edc.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
       AND ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = edc.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER
  LEFT JOIN dept_school_latest dsl
    ON ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dsl.DEPARTMENT_CODE
       AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsl.DEPARTMENT_NAME
       AND ss.SCHOOL_CODE = dsl.SCHOOL_CODE
       AND ss.SCHOOL_NAME = dsl.SCHOOL_NAME
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.mit_id) AS student_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.department_code) AS department_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.school_code) AS school_count
FROM moira_list ml
JOIN moira_list_detail mld
  ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
JOIN students_with_department_school s
  ON (
       (mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID = s.mit_id)
       OR
       (mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER IS NOT NULL AND mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER = s.student_identifier)
     )
WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'candle-duo-users'
  -- exclude members that do not match any student record by requiring a matched mit_id or identifier
  AND (s.mit_id IS NOT NULL OR s.student_identifier IS NOT NULL)

)
SELECT
  m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID AS member_mit_id,
  m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME AS member_full_name,
  -- all mailing lists this member subscribes to (distinct, comma separated)
  (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME ORDER BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME SEPARATOR ', ')
   FROM moira_list_detail mld
   JOIN moira_list ml ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
   WHERE COALESCE(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) = COALESCE(m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER)
  ) AS subscribed_mailing_lists,
  -- instructor name resolved from library_course_instructor (prefer exact name match to member full name)
  (SELECT lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME
   FROM library_course_instructor lci
   WHERE lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME = m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME
   LIMIT 1
  ) AS instructor_name,
  -- earliest and latest publication year (numeric) from reserve catalog linked through course instructor -> reserve detail -> catalog
  (SELECT MIN(c.CATALOG_YEAR + 0)
   FROM library_course_instructor lci
   JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail rmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = rmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
   JOIN library_reserve_catalog c ON rmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = c.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
   WHERE lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME = m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME
     AND c.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$'
  ) AS earliest_publication_year,
  (SELECT MAX(c.CATALOG_YEAR + 0)
   FROM library_course_instructor lci
   JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail rmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = rmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
   JOIN library_reserve_catalog c ON rmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = c.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
   WHERE lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME = m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME
     AND c.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$'
  ) AS latest_publication_year,
  -- total enrolled students: sum from library_instructor_enrollment for subjects where responsible faculty MIT id = member MIT id
  (SELECT SUM(lie.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS)
   FROM library_instructor_enrollment lie
   WHERE lie.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
  ) AS total_enrolled_students
FROM moira_list ml_root
JOIN moira_list_detail m ON m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml_root.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE ml_root.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'keeper-zephyr'
ORDER BY m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME

rows.question: For each unique mailing list with a name beginning with R (case insensitive), and that Professor Ayden Hopkins is subscribed to, list its name, description, owner, number of people in the list, and number of tenured faculty in the list.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH moira_list_metadata_with_owner AS (
SELECT
  m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
  m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  m.MOIRA_LIST_DESCRIPTION,
  m.IS_ACTIVE,
  o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY,
  o.OWNER
FROM moira_list AS m
LEFT JOIN moira_list_owner AS o
  ON m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
),
employee_directory_contact_normalized AS (
SELECT
  MIT_ID,
  LAST_NAME,
  FIRST_NAME,
  MIDDLE_NAME,
  FULL_NAME,
  DIRECTORY_FULL_NAME,
  OFFICE_LOCATION,
  OFFICE_PHONE,
  DIRECTORY_TITLE,
  PRIMARY_TITLE,
  DEPARTMENT_NUMBER,
  DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  KRB_NAME,
  KRB_NAME_UPPERCASE,
  EMAIL_ADDRESS,
  PERSONAL_URL,
  NAME_KNOWN_BY,
  EMAIL_ADDRESS_UPPERCASE,
  FULL_NAME_UPPERCASE,
  COALESCE(PREFERRED_FIRST_NAME, FIRST_NAME) AS PREFERRED_FIRST_NAME,
  COALESCE(PREFERRED_LAST_NAME, LAST_NAME) AS PREFERRED_LAST_NAME,
  COALESCE(PREFERRED_MIDDLE_NAME, MIDDLE_NAME) AS PREFERRED_MIDDLE_NAME
FROM employee_directory
),
moira_list_member_personnel_link AS (
SELECT
  mdl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
  mdl.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER,
  mdl.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID,
  -- Resolved personnel MIT_ID: prefer member-provided MIT (MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID),
  -- otherwise use matched personnel MIT_ID from se_person or opa_person_current
  COALESCE(NULLIF(mdl.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, ''), se.MIT_ID, opa.MIT_ID) AS PERSONNEL_MIT_ID,
  -- Prefer personnel full name from personnel tables, fall back to member string
  COALESCE(NULLIF(se.FULL_NAME, ''), NULLIF(opa.FULL_NAME, ''), NULLIF(mdl.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, '')) AS PERSONNEL_FULL_NAME,
  -- Payroll rank: come from opa_person_current.PAYROLL_RANK when available
  opa.PAYROLL_RANK,
  -- Source indicating which personnel table supplied the match
  CASE
    WHEN NULLIF(mdl.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, '') IS NOT NULL THEN 'moira_member_mit_id'
    WHEN se.MIT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'se_person'
    WHEN opa.MIT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'opa_person_current'
    ELSE 'none'
  END AS PERSON_SOURCE
FROM
  moira_list_detail mdl
  -- try to match moira member MIT ID to se_person (if se_person.MIT_ID exists)
  LEFT JOIN se_person se
    ON NULLIF(mdl.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, '') IS NOT NULL
       AND se.MIT_ID = mdl.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
  -- also try matching to opa_person_current by MIT_ID
  LEFT JOIN opa_person_current opa
    ON ( (NULLIF(mdl.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, '') IS NOT NULL AND opa.MIT_ID = mdl.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID)
         OR (se.MIT_ID IS NULL AND opa.EMAIL_ADDRESS IS NOT NULL AND mdl.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER LIKE CONCAT('%', opa.EMAIL_ADDRESS, '%')) )
),
moira_list_members_standardized AS (
SELECT
  d.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`,
  -- normalized member name: prefer normalized full name from directory when available, else raw member string
  COALESCE(ed.`FULL_NAME`, d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER`) AS `MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER`,
  -- prefer MIT_ID from moira detail; if empty, try to extract numeric MIT_ID from member string (lifted literal: pattern) ---
  -- Note: caller should supply patterns/literals if different; here we attempt simple digits extraction
  NULLIF(d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID`, '') AS `MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID`,
  d.`LAST_UPDATE_DATE`,
  d.`COUNTER`
FROM
  -- base membership detail table
  `moira_list_detail` d
LEFT JOIN
  -- normalized employee directory to canonicalize names and MIT_ID lookups where possible
  `employee_directory_contact_normalized` ed
    ON (
         -- join by MIT_ID when moira provides one
         (d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL AND d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID` <> '' AND ed.`MIT_ID` = d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID`)
         -- or attempt to match by email-like member strings to directory email (if callers want different logic, lift literals out)
         OR (d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER` IS NOT NULL AND d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER` <> '' AND ed.`EMAIL_ADDRESS` IS NOT NULL AND ed.`EMAIL_ADDRESS` <> '' AND LOWER(d.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER`) = LOWER(ed.`EMAIL_ADDRESS`))
       )
)
SELECT
  mmeta.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  mmeta.MOIRA_LIST_DESCRIPTION,
  mmeta.OWNER,
  -- total distinct members per list using MIT_ID when available else member name
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN mls.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND mls.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID <> ''
      THEN CONCAT('MIT:', mls.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID)
    ELSE CONCAT('NAME:', mls.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER)
  END) AS total_members,
  -- distinct members on the list who are tenured faculty (based on linked personnel PAYROLL_RANK)
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN mpl.PAYROLL_RANK = 'Faculty Tenured'
      THEN CASE
        WHEN mls.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND mls.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID <> ''
          THEN CONCAT('MIT:', mls.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID)
        ELSE CONCAT('NAME:', mls.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER)
      END
  END) AS tenured_faculty_count
FROM moira_list_metadata_with_owner AS mmeta
JOIN moira_list_members_standardized AS mls
  ON mmeta.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mls.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
-- left join to personnel link to surface payroll rank (may be null for non-linked members)
LEFT JOIN moira_list_member_personnel_link AS mpl
  ON mpl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mls.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  AND (
       (mpl.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND mpl.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID <> '' AND mpl.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID = mls.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID)
       OR
       (mpl.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER = mls.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER)
  )
WHERE mmeta.MOIRA_LIST_NAME LIKE 'R%' -- starts with R (case sensitive in MySQL); make case-insensitive:
  OR mmeta.MOIRA_LIST_NAME LIKE 'r%'
  -- ensure Professor Ayden Hopkins (Hopkins, Ayden) is subscribed to the list
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM moira_list_members_standardized AS sub
    WHERE sub.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mmeta.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
      AND (
            sub.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER = 'Hopkins, Ayden'
         OR sub.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID = (
               SELECT MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID
               FROM moira_list_members_standardized
               WHERE MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER = 'Hopkins, Ayden'
               LIMIT 1
             )
          )
  )
GROUP BY
  mmeta.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
  mmeta.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  mmeta.MOIRA_LIST_DESCRIPTION,
  mmeta.OWNER
ORDER BY mmeta.MOIRA_LIST_NAME

rows.question: For the email list with name 'date-destiny', list the name of the list, department name, the number of students from the Management department, and the percentage of students who are from the Management department, rounded to two decimal places.

  ml.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(s.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MANAGEMENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS management_count,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(s.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MANAGEMENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'date-destiny'

  ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  ml.DEPARTMENT_NAME

rows.question: For the building with the most floors, list the building name and the names of the mailing lists staring with a (case insensitive) that the building employees with kerberos starting with c (case insensitive) subscribe to.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH fac_rooms_space_area AS (
  SELECT
    fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY,
    fr.BUILDING_KEY,
    fb.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
    fb.BUILDING_NUMBER AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
    fr.FLOOR AS FLOOR,
    ff.FLOOR_KEY AS FLOOR_KEY,
    fr.ROOM,
    fr.SPACE_ID,
    fr.MAJOR_USE_KEY,
    fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC,
    fr.USE_KEY,
    fr.USE_DESC,
    fr.MINOR_USE_KEY,
    fr.MINOR_USE_DESC,
    fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY,
    fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    fr.MINOR_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
    fr.MINOR_ORGANIZATION,
    fr.AREA,
    fr.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
    fr.DEPT_CODE,
    fr.ACCESS_LEVEL,
    fr.LATITUDE_WGS,
    fr.LONGITUDE_WGS,
    fr.NORTHING_SPCS,
    fr.EASTING_SPCS,
    fr.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
    fr.FLOOR_KEY AS SOURCE_FLOOR_KEY,
    fr.FLOOR AS SOURCE_FLOOR
  FROM fac_rooms fr
  LEFT JOIN fac_building fb
    ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN fac_floor ff
    ON fr.FLOOR_KEY = ff.FLOOR_KEY
),
building_floor_rows_74 AS (
  SELECT
    fr.`BUILDING_KEY` AS `BUILDING_KEY`,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(fr.`SOURCE_FLOOR`, '') IS NOT NULL THEN fr.`SOURCE_FLOOR`
      WHEN NULLIF(fr.`SOURCE_FLOOR_KEY`, '') IS NOT NULL THEN
        TRIM(BOTH ' ' FROM
          CASE
            WHEN fr.`SOURCE_FLOOR_KEY` LIKE CONCAT(fr.`BUILDING_KEY`, '%') THEN
              TRIM(LEADING fr.`BUILDING_KEY` FROM fr.`SOURCE_FLOOR_KEY`)
            ELSE fr.`SOURCE_FLOOR_KEY`
          END
        )
      ELSE NULL
    END AS `FLOOR`,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(fr.`SOURCE_FLOOR_KEY`, '') IS NOT NULL THEN fr.`SOURCE_FLOOR_KEY`
      WHEN NULLIF(fr.`SOURCE_FLOOR`, '') IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(fr.`BUILDING_KEY`, '::', fr.`SOURCE_FLOOR`)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS `FLOOR_KEY`,
    fr.`BUILDING_NAME` AS `BUILDING_NAME`
  FROM `fac_rooms_space_area` fr
  WHERE
    NULLIF(fr.`BUILDING_KEY`, '') IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      NULLIF(fr.`SOURCE_FLOOR`, '') IS NOT NULL
      OR NULLIF(fr.`SOURCE_FLOOR_KEY`, '') IS NOT NULL
    )
  GROUP BY
    fr.`BUILDING_KEY`,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(fr.`SOURCE_FLOOR_KEY`, '') IS NOT NULL THEN fr.`SOURCE_FLOOR_KEY`
      WHEN NULLIF(fr.`SOURCE_FLOOR`, '') IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(fr.`BUILDING_KEY`, '::', fr.`SOURCE_FLOOR`)
      ELSE NULL
    END,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(fr.`SOURCE_FLOOR`, '') IS NOT NULL THEN fr.`SOURCE_FLOOR`
      WHEN NULLIF(fr.`SOURCE_FLOOR_KEY`, '') IS NOT NULL THEN
        TRIM(BOTH ' ' FROM
          CASE
            WHEN fr.`SOURCE_FLOOR_KEY` LIKE CONCAT(fr.`BUILDING_KEY`, '%') THEN
              TRIM(LEADING fr.`BUILDING_KEY` FROM fr.`SOURCE_FLOOR_KEY`)
            ELSE fr.`SOURCE_FLOOR_KEY`
          END
        )
      ELSE NULL
    END,
    fr.`BUILDING_NAME`
),
employee_directory_contact_normalized AS (
  SELECT
    MIT_ID,
    LAST_NAME,
    FIRST_NAME,
    MIDDLE_NAME,
    FULL_NAME,
    DIRECTORY_FULL_NAME,
    OFFICE_LOCATION,
    OFFICE_PHONE,
    DIRECTORY_TITLE,
    PRIMARY_TITLE,
    DEPARTMENT_NUMBER,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    KRB_NAME,
    KRB_NAME_UPPERCASE,
    EMAIL_ADDRESS,
    PERSONAL_URL,
    NAME_KNOWN_BY,
    EMAIL_ADDRESS_UPPERCASE,
    FULL_NAME_UPPERCASE,
    COALESCE(PREFERRED_FIRST_NAME, FIRST_NAME) AS PREFERRED_FIRST_NAME,
    COALESCE(PREFERRED_LAST_NAME, LAST_NAME) AS PREFERRED_LAST_NAME,
    COALESCE(PREFERRED_MIDDLE_NAME, MIDDLE_NAME) AS PREFERRED_MIDDLE_NAME
  FROM employee_directory
),
employee_office_location_krb AS (
  /* combine normalized employee_directory rows and raw employee_directory rows
     keeping MIT_ID and KRB_NAME and OFFICE_LOCATION; ensure uppercase KRB for comparisons */
  SELECT
    edn.MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
    edn.KRB_NAME AS KRB_NAME,
    UPPER(edn.KRB_NAME) AS KRB_NAME_UPPERCASE,
    edn.OFFICE_LOCATION AS OFFICE_LOCATION,
    COALESCE(edn.FULL_NAME, edn.DIRECTORY_FULL_NAME) AS FULL_NAME
  FROM employee_directory_contact_normalized edn

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    ed.MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
    ed.KRB_NAME AS KRB_NAME,
    UPPER(ed.KRB_NAME) AS KRB_NAME_UPPERCASE,
    ed.OFFICE_LOCATION AS OFFICE_LOCATION,
    COALESCE(ed.FULL_NAME, ed.DIRECTORY_FULL_NAME) AS FULL_NAME
  FROM employee_directory ed
  WHERE ed.MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM employee_directory_contact_normalized edn2
      WHERE edn2.MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID
        AND (
          (edn2.KRB_NAME IS NULL AND ed.KRB_NAME IS NULL)
          OR (edn2.KRB_NAME = ed.KRB_NAME)
        )
    )
),
building_with_max_floors AS (
  /* determine building(s) with max distinct floors; break ties by BUILDING_NAME lexicographically */
  SELECT BUILDING_KEY, BUILDING_NAME
  FROM (
    SELECT
      BUILDING_KEY,
      BUILDING_NAME,
      COUNT(DISTINCT FLOOR_KEY) AS floor_count,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT FLOOR_KEY) DESC, BUILDING_NAME ASC) AS rn
    FROM building_floor_rows_74
    GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY, BUILDING_NAME
  ) t
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
FROM building_with_max_floors b
-- match employees whose OFFICE_LOCATION equals the building key and whose kerberos starts with 'c' (case-insensitive)
JOIN employee_office_location_krb e
  ON e.OFFICE_LOCATION = b.BUILDING_KEY
    AND (e.KRB_NAME_UPPERCASE IS NOT NULL AND e.KRB_NAME_UPPERCASE LIKE 'C%')
-- join moira_list_detail by either MIT id match or member name match (case-insensitive)
JOIN moira_list_detail mld
  ON (
       (mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID = e.MIT_ID)
       OR (mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) = e.KRB_NAME_UPPERCASE)
     )
JOIN moira_list ml
  ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
-- only include mailing lists whose name starts with 'a' (case-insensitive)
WHERE UPPER(ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'A%'
GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME, ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
ORDER BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME

rows.question: For students with last names starting with H who are subscribed to mailing list 'beacon-date-date', list the names of the students, the phone numbers of departments they belong to, and the size of the mailing list 'beacon-date-date' that they are subscribed to.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT 
  s.MIT_ID AS STUDENT_MIT_ID,
  s.LAST_NAME,
  s.FIRST_NAME,
  d.OFFICE_PHONE AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE,
  m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  m.MOIRA_LIST_SIZE
FROM drupal_course_catalog AS cc
JOIN drupal_employee_directory AS s
  ON s.MIT_ID = cc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
JOIN employee_directory AS d
  ON d.MIT_ID = s.MIT_ID
JOIN (
  SELECT 
    MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    MEMBER_MIT_ID,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY MOIRA_LIST_NAME) AS MOIRA_LIST_SIZE
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      'beacon-date-date' AS MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
      MEMBER_MIT_ID
    FROM (
      SELECT 
        MEMBER_MIT_ID
      FROM (
        SELECT RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS MEMBER_MIT_ID
        FROM drupal_course_catalog
        WHERE RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
      ) AS t1
      WHERE MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
    ) AS t2
    WHERE 1=1
  ) AS t3
) AS m
  ON m.MEMBER_MIT_ID = s.MIT_ID
WHERE s.LAST_NAME LIKE 'H%'
  AND m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'beacon-date-date'

rows.question: Give the count of mailing lists with names starting with B that include members from the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department, along with the name of the list starting with B that have the highest number of members from that department and the corresponding member count of members associated with the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH person_org_lookup_candidates AS (
  SELECT
    'employee_directory' AS source_table,
    'MIT_ID' AS person_id_column,
    `MIT_ID` AS person_id_value,
    `DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS organization_field_value
  FROM `employee_directory`
  WHERE `MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'employee_directory' AS source_table,
    'KRB_NAME' AS person_id_column,
    `KRB_NAME` AS person_id_value,
    `DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS organization_field_value
  FROM `employee_directory`
  WHERE `KRB_NAME` IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'drupal_employee_directory' AS source_table,
    'MIT_ID' AS person_id_column,
    `MIT_ID` AS person_id_value,
    `HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE` AS organization_field_value
  FROM `drupal_employee_directory`
  WHERE `MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'drupal_employee_directory' AS source_table,
    'MIT_ID' AS person_id_column,
    `MIT_ID` AS person_id_value,
    `EMPLOYEE_GROUP` AS organization_field_value
  FROM `drupal_employee_directory`
  WHERE `MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL
),
-- helper to normalize a member identifier per detail row
detail_members AS (
  SELECT
    d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER,
    d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, ''), NULLIF(d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, '')) AS member_id_normalized
  FROM moira_list_detail d
  WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, ''), NULLIF(d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, '')) IS NOT NULL
),
-- per list, set of distinct member identifiers that resolve to the target organization
list_eecs_members AS (
  SELECT
    m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    dm.member_id_normalized AS member_id
  FROM moira_list m
  JOIN detail_members dm ON dm.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  JOIN person_org_lookup_candidates p
    ON p.person_id_value = dm.member_id_normalized
  WHERE m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME LIKE 'B%'
    AND p.organization_field_value = 'Electrical Engineering-Computer Science'
  GROUP BY m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME, dm.member_id_normalized
)
SELECT
  -- total number of distinct B* lists that have one or more EECS members
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MOIRA_LIST_KEY) FROM list_eecs_members) AS total_b_lists_with_eecs_members,
  -- the single B* list name with the largest number of distinct EECS members (NULL if none)
  (SELECT t.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
   FROM (
     SELECT
       MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
       MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
       COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS eecs_member_count
     FROM list_eecs_members
     GROUP BY MOIRA_LIST_KEY, MOIRA_LIST_NAME
     ORDER BY eecs_member_count DESC
     LIMIT 1
   ) t
  ) AS top_list_name,
  -- the corresponding EECS member count for that top list (0 if none)
  (SELECT IFNULL(t.eecs_member_count, 0)
   FROM (
     SELECT
       COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS eecs_member_count
     FROM list_eecs_members
     GROUP BY MOIRA_LIST_KEY
     ORDER BY eecs_member_count DESC
     LIMIT 1
   ) t
  ) AS top_list_eecs_member_count

rows.question: For each department, what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any course offered by that department in 2019, what is the name of the responsible faculty member for that course, and what is the average number of enrolled students for all such courses in that department, considering only courses where the maximum number of enrolled students is greater than 5, and only including departments of Mathematics (Course 18) and Chemistry (Course 5)? Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject AS (
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SCHOOL_CODE,
    SCHOOL_NAME,
    SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_number,
    SUM(COALESCE(CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, 0)) AS total_cluster_enrollment_number,
    SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_CREDIT, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_credit,
    SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_LISTEN, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_listen,
    SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_FIRST_WEEK, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_first_week,
    SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_FIFTH_WEEK, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_fifth_week,
    MAX(WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS last_warehouse_load_date
  FROM subject_summary
  GROUP BY
    TERM_CODE,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SCHOOL_CODE,
    SCHOOL_NAME
),
subject_offered_latest_by_section AS (
  SELECT
    SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
    COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY,
    TERM_CODE,
    MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER,
    MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER_SORT,
    MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER_DESC,
    MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
    COURSE_NUMBER,
    COURSE_NUMBER_SORT,
    COURSE_NUMBER_DESC,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    SECTION_ID,
    IS_MASTER_SECTION,
    IS_LECTURE_SECTION,
    IS_LAB_SECTION,
    IS_RECITATION_SECTION,
    IS_DESIGN_SECTION,
    OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
    OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME,
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    MEET_TIME,
    MEET_PLACE,
    CLUSTER_TYPE,
    CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC,
    CLUSTER_LIST,
    HGN_CODE,
    HGN_CODE_DESC,
    FORM_TYPE,
    FORM_TYPE_DESC,
    SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
    SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
    CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
    EVALUATE_THIS_SUBJECT,
    IS_OSE_SUBJECT,
    IS_CREATED_BY_DATA_WAREHOUSE,
    SUBJECT_GROUPING_KEY,
    WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
    NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
    SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY,
    IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY SECTION_ID
      ORDER BY COALESCE(WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, '') DESC, SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY DESC
    ) AS section_row_rank
  FROM subject_offered
),
subject_offered_201x_course_rows AS (
  SELECT
    -- carry-through keys to preserve joinability / grain
    CONCAT_WS('|', sols.`SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY`, sols.`SECTION_ID`, sols.`COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY`) AS `SUBJECT_OFFERED_ROW_KEY`,
    sols.`TERM_CODE` AS `TERM_CODE`,
    sols.`OFFER_DEPT_NAME` AS `OFFER_DEPT_NAME`,
    COALESCE(ss.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`, sols.`OFFER_DEPT_NAME`) AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    -- subject enrollment fields: prefer section-level subject_enrollment_number, else aggregate lookup or num_enrolled_students
    CASE
      WHEN sols.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND sols.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER <> '' THEN CAST(sols.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER AS DECIMAL(18,6))
      WHEN sse.total_subject_enrollment_number IS NOT NULL THEN sse.total_subject_enrollment_number
      WHEN sols.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS IS NOT NULL THEN sols.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
      ELSE NULL
    END AS ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
    sols.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME` AS `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`,
    sols.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` AS `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`,
    sols.`SUBJECT_ID` AS `SUBJECT_ID`,
    sols.`COURSE_NUMBER` AS `COURSE_NUMBER`,
    sols.`SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY` AS `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY`,
    sols.`SECTION_ID` AS `SECTION_ID`,
    sols.`COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY` AS `SUBJECT_KEY`
  FROM subject_offered_latest_by_section sols
  LEFT JOIN subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject sse
    ON sse.`TERM_CODE` = sols.`TERM_CODE`
   AND sse.`SUBJECT_ID` = sols.`SUBJECT_ID`
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID, DEPARTMENT_NAME
    FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject
  ) ss
    ON ss.`SUBJECT_ID` = sols.`SUBJECT_ID`
  WHERE sols.section_row_rank = 1
)
SELECT
  stats.DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  stats.MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
  fam.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
  stats.AVG_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
FROM (
  -- compute per-department stats for 2019
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(OFFER_DEPT_NAME,''), NULLIF(DEPARTMENT_NAME,'')) AS DEPT_NAME,
    MAX(ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
    AVG(ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS AVG_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM subject_offered_201x_course_rows
  WHERE TERM_CODE LIKE '%2019%'
    AND (
      OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
      OR DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
      OR OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'
      OR DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Chemistry'
    )
    AND ENROLLED_STUDENTS IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(OFFER_DEPT_NAME,''), NULLIF(DEPARTMENT_NAME,''))
) AS stats
JOIN (
  -- pick a responsible faculty for a course that has the max enrollment for the department
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(OFFER_DEPT_NAME,''), NULLIF(DEPARTMENT_NAME,'')) AS DEPT_NAME,
    ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS ENROLL,
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
  FROM subject_offered_201x_course_rows
  WHERE TERM_CODE LIKE '%2019%'
    AND (
      OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
      OR DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
      OR OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'
      OR DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Chemistry'
    )
    AND ENROLLED_STUDENTS IS NOT NULL
) AS fam
  ON fam.DEPT_NAME = stats.DEPT_NAME
  AND fam.ENROLL = stats.MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
WHERE stats.MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5

rows.question: For each assignable organization (excluding 'ADMISSIONS' and those with organization IDs '138' and '250'), provide the organization name, the average and variance of the HR department codes for its associated HR org units, and the number of HR org units per organization, considering only those with a non-null HR department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH fac_rooms_space_area AS (
  SELECT
    fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY,
    fr.BUILDING_KEY,
    fb.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
    fb.BUILDING_NUMBER AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
    fr.FLOOR AS FLOOR,
    ff.FLOOR_KEY AS FLOOR_KEY,
    fr.ROOM,
    fr.SPACE_ID,
    fr.MAJOR_USE_KEY,
    fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC,
    fr.USE_KEY,
    fr.USE_DESC,
    fr.MINOR_USE_KEY,
    fr.MINOR_USE_DESC,
    fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY,
    fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    fr.MINOR_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
    fr.MINOR_ORGANIZATION,
    fr.AREA,
    fr.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
    fr.DEPT_CODE,
    fr.ACCESS_LEVEL,
    fr.LATITUDE_WGS,
    fr.LONGITUDE_WGS,
    fr.NORTHING_SPCS,
    fr.EASTING_SPCS,
    fr.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
  FROM fac_rooms fr
  LEFT JOIN fac_building fb
    ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN fac_floor ff
    ON fr.FLOOR_KEY = ff.FLOOR_KEY
),
fclt_organization_assignable_cohort AS (
  SELECT
    fr.`ORGANIZATION_KEY` AS `ORGANIZATION_KEY`,
    fr.`DEPT_CODE`            AS `ORGANIZATION_ID`,
    fr.`ORGANIZATION_NAME`    AS `ORGANIZATION_NAME`,
    1                         AS `ASSIGNABLE`
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      `ORGANIZATION_KEY`,
      `ORGANIZATION_NAME`,
      `DEPT_CODE`,
      `AREA`
    FROM `fac_rooms_space_area`
    WHERE `ORGANIZATION_KEY` IS NOT NULL
      AND `ORGANIZATION_KEY` <> ''
      AND `AREA` IS NOT NULL
      AND `AREA` > 0
  ) AS fr
  WHERE
    -- treat ASSIGNABLE as Y/N semantics: we included only orgs with assignable area above;
    -- also exclude explicit non-assignable marker if present in DEPT_CODE (handled downstream if needed)
    1 = 1
),
fclt_org_to_hr_org_unit_join AS (
  SELECT
    fr.`ORGANIZATION_KEY` AS `ORGANIZATION_KEY`,
    fr.`ORGANIZATION_ID`  AS `ORGANIZATION_ID`,
    fr.`ORGANIZATION_NAME` AS `ORGANIZATION_NAME`,
    ed.`DEPARTMENT_NUMBER` AS `HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY`,
    ed.`DEPARTMENT_NUMBER` AS `HR_ORG_UNIT_ID`,
    -- extract numeric portion; if extraction yields empty string, result will be NULL
    NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.`DEPARTMENT_NUMBER`, '[^0-9]', ''), '') + 0 AS `HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_NUM`
  FROM fclt_organization_assignable_cohort fr
  LEFT JOIN employee_directory ed
    ON (
         (fr.`ORGANIZATION_ID` IS NOT NULL AND fr.`ORGANIZATION_ID` <> '' AND ed.`DEPARTMENT_NUMBER` = fr.`ORGANIZATION_ID`)
         OR
         ((fr.`ORGANIZATION_ID` IS NULL OR fr.`ORGANIZATION_ID` = '') AND LOWER(NULLIF(fr.`ORGANIZATION_NAME`, '')) = LOWER(NULLIF(ed.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`, '')))
       )
  WHERE
    ed.`DEPARTMENT_NUMBER` IS NOT NULL
    AND ed.`DEPARTMENT_NUMBER` <> ''
    -- ensure REGEXP_REPLACE yields at least one digit; if not, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_NUM will be 0+'' => NULL filtered later
    AND REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.`DEPARTMENT_NUMBER`, '[^0-9]', '') <> ''
  GROUP BY
    fr.`ORGANIZATION_KEY`,
    fr.`ORGANIZATION_ID`,
    fr.`ORGANIZATION_NAME`,
    ed.`DEPARTMENT_NUMBER`
)
SELECT
  o.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  AVG(j.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_NUM) AS AVG_HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  -- population variance: E[X^2] - (E[X])^2
  (AVG(j.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_NUM * j.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_NUM) - AVG(j.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_NUM) * AVG(j.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_NUM)) AS VAR_HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  COUNT(DISTINCT j.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS HR_ORG_UNIT_COUNT
FROM fclt_organization_assignable_cohort o
JOIN fclt_org_to_hr_org_unit_join j
  ON o.ORGANIZATION_KEY = j.ORGANIZATION_KEY
WHERE o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS'
  AND (o.ORGANIZATION_ID IS NULL OR o.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138','250'))
  AND j.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_NUM IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME
ORDER BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME

rows.question: For each school, what is the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the department budget codes among its departments, what is the full name of the school, and how many unique subject codes are associated with the departments in that school? Only include schools that have a department named "Political Science". Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject AS (
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SCHOOL_CODE,
    SCHOOL_NAME,
    SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_number,
    SUM(COALESCE(CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, 0)) AS total_cluster_enrollment_number,
    SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_CREDIT, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_credit,
    SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_LISTEN, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_listen,
    SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_FIRST_WEEK, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_first_week,
    SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_FIFTH_WEEK, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_fifth_week,
    MAX(WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS last_warehouse_load_date
  FROM subject_summary
  GROUP BY
    TERM_CODE,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SCHOOL_CODE,
    SCHOOL_NAME
),
sis_department_budget_codes AS (
  -- derive one row per department with numeric dept budget code when possible
  SELECT
    sa.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    MAX(sa.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    -- take SCHOOL_CODE as the raw budget-code-like field (as in original)
    MAX(sa.SCHOOL_CODE) AS DEPT_BUDGET_CODE_RAW,
    CASE
      WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(MAX(sa.SCHOOL_CODE), '')) = '' THEN NULL
      WHEN REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(COALESCE(MAX(sa.SCHOOL_CODE), '')), '[^0-9\\-]', '') = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(COALESCE(MAX(sa.SCHOOL_CODE), '')), '[^0-9\\-]', '') AS SIGNED)
    END AS DEPT_BUDGET_CODE_NUM,
    MAX(sa.SCHOOL_NAME) AS SCHOOL_NAME
  FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject sa
  GROUP BY sa.DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
subject_codes_by_department AS (
  -- pick the latest (by term and load date) subject code per subject, associate to department
  SELECT
    so.SUBJECT_CODE,
    so.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    so.SCHOOL_NAME
  FROM (
    SELECT
      ss.SCHOOL_NAME,
      ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(ss.SUBJECT_ID, ''), NULLIF(ss.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, '')) AS SUBJECT_CODE,
      ss.TERM_CODE,
      ss.last_warehouse_load_date,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(ss.SUBJECT_ID, ''), NULLIF(ss.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, ''))
        ORDER BY ss.TERM_CODE DESC, ss.last_warehouse_load_date DESC
      ) AS rn
    FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject ss
  ) so
  WHERE so.rn = 1
)
SELECT
  s.SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  STDDEV(s.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE_NUM) AS STDDEV_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS UNIQUE_SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT
FROM sis_department_budget_codes s
LEFT JOIN subject_codes_by_department sc
  ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IN (
  -- include only schools that have at least one department named 'Political Science'
  SELECT DISTINCT SCHOOL_NAME
  FROM sis_department_budget_codes
  WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'
     OR DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17'
)
GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME

rows.question: For the top 10 degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science), provide the department name, school name, the total number of unique courses they offer, and indicate whether the department is a 'LARGE_DEPT' (if it offers at least 20% more courses than the average among these departments), 'SMALL_DEPT' (if it offers at least 20% fewer), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH subject_offered_latest_by_section AS (
SELECT
  SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
  COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY,
  TERM_CODE,
  MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER,
  MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER_SORT,
  MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER_DESC,
  MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
  MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
  COURSE_NUMBER,
  COURSE_NUMBER_SORT,
  COURSE_NUMBER_DESC,
  SUBJECT_ID,
  SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
  SUBJECT_TITLE,
  SECTION_ID,
  IS_MASTER_SECTION,
  IS_LECTURE_SECTION,
  IS_LAB_SECTION,
  IS_RECITATION_SECTION,
  IS_DESIGN_SECTION,
  OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
  OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME,
  RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
  RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
  MEET_TIME,
  MEET_PLACE,
  CLUSTER_TYPE,
  CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC,
  CLUSTER_LIST,
  HGN_CODE,
  HGN_CODE_DESC,
  FORM_TYPE,
  FORM_TYPE_DESC,
  SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
  SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
  CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
  EVALUATE_THIS_SUBJECT,
  IS_OSE_SUBJECT,
  IS_CREATED_BY_DATA_WAREHOUSE,
  SUBJECT_GROUPING_KEY,
  WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
  NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
  SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY,
  IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY SECTION_ID
    ORDER BY COALESCE(WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, '') DESC, SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY DESC
  ) AS section_row_rank
FROM subject_offered
),
degree_granting_departments AS (
SELECT
  d.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
  d.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
  d.`SCHOOL_CODE` AS `SCHOOL_CODE`,
  d.`SCHOOL_NAME` AS `SCHOOL_NAME`,
  -- carry through whatever flag column indicates degree granting; lift literal mapping out of view
  d.`IS_DEGREE_GRANTING` AS `IS_DEGREE_GRANTING`
FROM
  -- source SIS department table(s). Use `course_catalog_subject_offered` as the authoritative SIS-derived department listing:
  (
    SELECT
      DISTINCT
      COALESCE(`DEPARTMENT_CODE`, '') AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
      COALESCE(`DEPARTMENT_NAME`, '') AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
      COALESCE(`DEPARTMENT_CODE`, '') /* placeholder for SCHOOL_CODE if not present */ AS `SCHOOL_CODE`,
      '' AS `SCHOOL_NAME`,
      -- many SIS extracts represent degree-granting as 'Y'/'N' or '1'/'0' or NULL.
      -- Leave the raw value through; callers should filter/normalize as needed.
      NULL AS `IS_DEGREE_GRANTING`
    FROM
      `course_catalog_subject_offered`
    WHERE
      `DEPARTMENT_CODE` IS NOT NULL
  ) AS d
),
subject_offerings_union_subjectid AS (
SELECT
  'cis_course_catalog' AS SOURCE_TABLE,
  `EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE,
  `DEPARTMENT_CODE` AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  `DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  `SUBJECT_ID` AS SUBJECT_ID,
  `SUBJECT_NUMBER` AS COURSE_NUMBER,
  `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
  `SUBJECT_TITLE` AS SUBJECT_TITLE
FROM `cis_course_catalog`
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'course_catalog_subject_offered' AS SOURCE_TABLE,
  `TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE,
  `DEPARTMENT_CODE` AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  `DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  `SUBJECT_ID` AS SUBJECT_ID,
  `SUBJECT_NUMBER` AS COURSE_NUMBER,
  `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
  `SUBJECT_TITLE` AS SUBJECT_TITLE
FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered`
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'drupal_course_catalog' AS SOURCE_TABLE,
  `EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE,
  `DEPARTMENT_CODE` AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  `DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  `SUBJECT_ID` AS SUBJECT_ID,
  `SUBJECT_NUMBER` AS COURSE_NUMBER,
  `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
  `SUBJECT_TITLE` AS SUBJECT_TITLE
FROM `drupal_course_catalog`
UNION ALL
-- include subject_offered_latest_by_section view if present to capture section-level rows
SELECT
  'subject_offered_latest_by_section' AS SOURCE_TABLE,
  `TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE,
  `OFFER_DEPT_CODE` AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  `OFFER_DEPT_NAME` AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  `SUBJECT_ID` AS SUBJECT_ID,
  `COURSE_NUMBER` AS COURSE_NUMBER,
  `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
  `SUBJECT_TITLE` AS SUBJECT_TITLE
FROM `subject_offered_latest_by_section`
)
SELECT
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME,
  counts.TOTAL_UNIQUE_COURSES,
  CASE
    WHEN counts.TOTAL_UNIQUE_COURSES >= 1.20 * avgvals.AVG_TOP10 THEN 'LARGE_DEPT'
    WHEN counts.TOTAL_UNIQUE_COURSES <= 0.80 * avgvals.AVG_TOP10 THEN 'SMALL_DEPT'
    ELSE 'AVERAGE'
  END AS DEPARTMENT_SIZE_LABEL
FROM (
  -- top 10 degree-granting departments by unique course count (excluding Political Science)
  SELECT
    dg.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    dg.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    dg.SCHOOL_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(so.SUBJECT_ID, so.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS TOTAL_UNIQUE_COURSES
  FROM degree_granting_departments dg
  LEFT JOIN subject_offerings_union_subjectid so
    ON so.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dg.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE dg.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING IS NOT NULL
    AND dg.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science'
  GROUP BY dg.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dg.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dg.SCHOOL_NAME
  ORDER BY TOTAL_UNIQUE_COURSES DESC
  LIMIT 10
) AS counts
JOIN (
  -- bring department names/school for those top 10 (counts already has them, but keep joinable pattern)
  SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME
  FROM degree_granting_departments
) d
  ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN (
  -- compute the average TOTAL_UNIQUE_COURSES across the selected top 10 rows
  SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNIQUE_COURSES) AS AVG_TOP10
  FROM (
    SELECT
      COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(so.SUBJECT_ID, so.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS TOTAL_UNIQUE_COURSES
    FROM degree_granting_departments dg
    LEFT JOIN subject_offerings_union_subjectid so
      ON so.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dg.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    WHERE dg.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING IS NOT NULL
      AND dg.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science'
    GROUP BY dg.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    ORDER BY TOTAL_UNIQUE_COURSES DESC
    LIMIT 10
  ) t
) avgvals

rows.question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description and the geometric mean of the total units for subjects offered in terms where the material status is 'U' and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), and only include those academic years where this geometric mean is greater than the overall geometric mean of total units for all such subjects across all years? Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH math_subjects AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dcc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cis.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    COALESCE(ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cis.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COALESCE(ccs.TERM_CODE, dcc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, cis.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE) AS TERM_CODE,
    COALESCE(ccs.TOTAL_UNITS, dcc.TOTAL_UNITS, cis.TOTAL_UNITS) AS TOTAL_UNITS,
    COALESCE(ccs.HGN_CODE, dcc.HGN_CODE, cis.HGN_CODE) AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
    COALESCE(ccs.SUBJECT_ID, dcc.SUBJECT_ID, cis.SUBJECT_ID) AS SUBJECT_ID
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered ccs
  LEFT JOIN drupal_course_catalog dcc
    ON ccs.SUBJECT_ID = dcc.SUBJECT_ID
    AND COALESCE(ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, ccs.TERM_CODE) = dcc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
  LEFT JOIN cis_course_catalog cis
    ON ccs.SUBJECT_ID = cis.SUBJECT_ID
    AND COALESCE(ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, ccs.TERM_CODE) = cis.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
  WHERE COALESCE(ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cis.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'Mathematics'
    AND COALESCE(ccs.HGN_CODE, dcc.HGN_CODE, cis.HGN_CODE) = 'U'
    AND COALESCE(ccs.TOTAL_UNITS, dcc.TOTAL_UNITS, cis.TOTAL_UNITS) IS NOT NULL
),
per_year_stats AS (
  SELECT
    ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    ACADEMIC_YEAR AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_KEY,
    EXP(AVG(LN(TOTAL_UNITS))) AS GEOMETRIC_MEAN_TOTAL_UNITS
  FROM math_subjects
  WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0
  GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT
    EXP(AVG(LN(TOTAL_UNITS))) AS OVERALL_GEOMETRIC_MEAN
  FROM math_subjects
  WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0
)
SELECT
  pys.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
  pys.GEOMETRIC_MEAN_TOTAL_UNITS
FROM per_year_stats pys
JOIN academic_terms_all at
  ON at.ACADEMIC_YEAR = pys.ACADEMIC_YEAR
CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
WHERE pys.GEOMETRIC_MEAN_TOTAL_UNITS > os.OVERALL_GEOMETRIC_MEAN
ORDER BY pys.ACADEMIC_YEAR

rows.question: For each department, provide the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), and the department phone number. Only include departments that have at least one subject with more than 0 total units, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH employee_directory_contact_normalized AS (
SELECT
  MIT_ID,
  LAST_NAME,
  FIRST_NAME,
  MIDDLE_NAME,
  FULL_NAME,
  DIRECTORY_FULL_NAME,
  OFFICE_LOCATION,
  OFFICE_PHONE,
  DIRECTORY_TITLE,
  PRIMARY_TITLE,
  DEPARTMENT_NUMBER,
  DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  KRB_NAME,
  KRB_NAME_UPPERCASE,
  EMAIL_ADDRESS,
  PERSONAL_URL,
  NAME_KNOWN_BY,
  EMAIL_ADDRESS_UPPERCASE,
  FULL_NAME_UPPERCASE,
  COALESCE(PREFERRED_FIRST_NAME, FIRST_NAME) AS PREFERRED_FIRST_NAME,
  COALESCE(PREFERRED_LAST_NAME, LAST_NAME) AS PREFERRED_LAST_NAME,
  COALESCE(PREFERRED_MIDDLE_NAME, MIDDLE_NAME) AS PREFERRED_MIDDLE_NAME
FROM employee_directory
),
sis_admin_department_phone AS (
SELECT
  -- department code is the grain/key
  ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER AS SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  -- department name from normalized employee directory when available
  COALESCE(ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL) AS SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  -- normalize office phone into area code (first 3 digits) when phone present and looks like NPA-NXX-XXXX or (NPA) NXX-XXXX or continuous digits
  NULLIF(
    -- extract only digits then take left 3 as area code when at least 10 digits
    CASE
      WHEN ed.OFFICE_PHONE IS NULL OR TRIM(ed.OFFICE_PHONE) = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE
        -- remove all non-digit characters
        (SELECT
           CASE
             WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '[^0-9]', '')) >= 10
               THEN LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '[^0-9]', ''), 3)
             WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '[^0-9]', '')) BETWEEN 7 AND 9
               THEN LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '[^0-9]', ''), 3)
             ELSE NULL
           END
         )
    END
  , '') AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE,
  -- phone number normalized to 7-digit or remaining digits after area code
  NULLIF(
    CASE
      WHEN ed.OFFICE_PHONE IS NULL OR TRIM(ed.OFFICE_PHONE) = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE
        (SELECT
           CASE
             WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '[^0-9]', '')) >= 10
               THEN SUBSTRING(REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '[^0-9]', ''), 4) -- remaining digits after area code
             WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '[^0-9]', '')) BETWEEN 7 AND 9
               THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '[^0-9]', '') -- keep all digits (no area code)
             ELSE NULL
           END
         )
    END
  , '') AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
  -- Pretty concatenated phone: if area code present, format as (area) xxx-xxxx when possible, otherwise return original office phone
  CASE
    WHEN ed.OFFICE_PHONE IS NULL OR TRIM(ed.OFFICE_PHONE) = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE
      (SELECT
         CASE
           WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '[^0-9]', '')) >= 10
             THEN CONCAT('(', LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '[^0-9]', ''),3), ') ',
                         -- format last 7 digits as xxx-xxxx when length >=10
                         CONCAT(
                           SUBSTRING(REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '[^0-9]', ''),4,3),
                           '-',
                           SUBSTRING(REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '[^0-9]', ''),7,4)
                         )
                    )
           WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '[^0-9]', '')) = 7
             THEN CONCAT(
                    SUBSTRING(REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '[^0-9]', ''),1,3),
                    '-',
                    SUBSTRING(REGEXP_REPLACE(ed.OFFICE_PHONE, '[^0-9]', ''),4,4)
                  )
           ELSE
             -- fallback to the raw office phone string trimmed
             TRIM(ed.OFFICE_PHONE)
         END
       )
  END AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE
FROM
  -- source: normalized employee directory contact info
  employee_directory_contact_normalized ed
-- Group to one row per department code: pick the first non-null department phone/name per department
-- Use windowed DISTINCT-style selection by choosing row_number over department_number ordered by OFFICE_PHONE presence
WHERE
  ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  ed.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER
)
SELECT
  ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  STDDEV(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) / AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS COEFFICIENT_OF_VARIATION,
  COALESCE(d.DEPARTMENT_PHONE, CONCAT(d.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER)) AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE
FROM
  subject_summary ss
LEFT JOIN
  sis_admin_department_phone d

rows.question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and the total number of units for all subjects offered in terms with a term status of 'Previous', where the total number of units is greater than 100, and only include subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18). Additionally, for each such academic year, report the number of subjects that are classified as undergraduate (HGN_DESC = 'Undergraduate'), and only include academic years where at least 60% of the subjects are undergraduate. Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH prev_terms AS (
  SELECT
    `ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY`,
    `ACADEMIC_YEAR`,
    `ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC`,
    `TERM_CODE`
  FROM `academic_terms`
  WHERE `TERM_STATUS` = 'Previous'
),
math_subjects AS (
  SELECT
    c.`ACADEMIC_YEAR`,
    c.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_KEY, -- carry-through id-like column
    c.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_RET,
    c.`SUBJECT_ID`,
    c.`SUBJECT_CODE`,
    c.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    c.`TOTAL_UNITS`,
    c.`HGN_DESC`,
    c.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE`
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered` c
  WHERE c.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` = 'Mathematics'
),
subjects_in_prev_terms AS (
  SELECT
    m.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    m.ACADEMIC_YEAR_RET,
    m.SUBJECT_ID,
    m.SUBJECT_CODE,
    m.TOTAL_UNITS,
    m.HGN_DESC,
    m.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
  FROM math_subjects m
  JOIN prev_terms t
    ON m.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
),
agg_by_year AS (
  SELECT
    s.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    s.ACADEMIC_YEAR_RET,
    SUM(COALESCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS,0)) AS TOTAL_UNITS_SUM,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS NUM_SUBJECTS_TOTAL,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.HGN_DESC = 'Undergraduate' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) /* counts distinct subjects that are undergraduate */ 
      * 1.0 AS undergraduate_raw_count -- intermediate
  FROM subjects_in_prev_terms s
  GROUP BY s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR_RET
),
agg_final AS (
  SELECT
    a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_RET AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    a.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DUP,
    a.TOTAL_UNITS_SUM,
    a.NUM_SUBJECTS_TOTAL,
    -- Need distinct count of undergraduate subjects: recompute reliably
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s2.SUBJECT_ID)
     FROM subjects_in_prev_terms s2
     WHERE s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR
       AND s2.HGN_DESC = 'Undergraduate'
    ) AS NUM_SUBJECTS_UNDERGRAD
  FROM agg_by_year a
)
SELECT
  -- use academic_year_desc from prev_terms (pick one for the year)
  (SELECT t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
   FROM prev_terms t
   WHERE t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = f.ACADEMIC_YEAR
   LIMIT 1) AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
  f.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  f.TOTAL_UNITS_SUM,
  f.NUM_SUBJECTS_TOTAL,
  f.NUM_SUBJECTS_UNDERGRAD,
  (f.NUM_SUBJECTS_UNDERGRAD / f.NUM_SUBJECTS_TOTAL) AS PCT_UNDERGRAD
FROM agg_final f
WHERE f.TOTAL_UNITS_SUM > 100
  AND f.NUM_SUBJECTS_TOTAL > 0
  AND (f.NUM_SUBJECTS_UNDERGRAD / f.NUM_SUBJECTS_TOTAL) >= 0.6

rows.question: For each department in the 2022 academic year, provide the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for letter graded subjects, along with the school name and department phone number. Only include departments that are degree-granting and exclude the Biology department. Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject AS (
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SCHOOL_CODE,
    SCHOOL_NAME,
    SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_number,
    SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_CREDIT,0))  AS total_subject_enrollment_credit,
    MAX(WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS last_warehouse_load_date
  FROM subject_summary
  GROUP BY
    TERM_CODE,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SCHOOL_CODE,
    SCHOOL_NAME
),
sis_department_phone AS (
  SELECT
    `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE` AS SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    NULLIF(TRIM(`DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER`), '') AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER_RAW,
    NULLIF(TRIM(`DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE`), '') AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(`DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER`), '') IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(`DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE`), '') IS NULL THEN NULLIF(TRIM(`DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER`), '')
      ELSE CONCAT('(', TRIM(`DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE`), ') ', TRIM(`DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER`))
    END AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER_ASSEMBLED
  FROM sis_admin_department
),
sis_degree_granting_departments AS (
  SELECT
    d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    d.SCHOOL_CODE,
    d.SCHOOL_NAME,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject s
       WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SCHOOL_CODE, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME
    FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
    WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SCHOOL_CODE, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME
    FROM cis_course_catalog
    WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS SCHOOL_CODE, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME
    FROM drupal_course_catalog
    WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL
  ) d
)
SELECT
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  -- prefer school name from cis_course_catalog (aliased cc) if available, otherwise department's school_name (which may be NULL)
  COALESCE(cc.SCHOOL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME) AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  p.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER_ASSEMBLED AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
  AVG(su.TOTAL_UNITS) AS AVG_TOTAL_UNITS,
  (MAX(su.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(su.TOTAL_UNITS)) AS RANGE_TOTAL_UNITS,
  -- population variance: E[X^2] - (E[X])^2
  (SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS * su.TOTAL_UNITS) / COUNT(*) - AVG(su.TOTAL_UNITS) * AVG(su.TOTAL_UNITS)) AS VARIANCE_TOTAL_UNITS
FROM sis_degree_granting_departments d
LEFT JOIN sis_department_phone p
  ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = p.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN cis_course_catalog cc
  ON cc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN subject_summary su
  ON su.SUBJECT_ID = cc.SUBJECT_ID
     AND su.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2022'
WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
  AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7'
  AND cc.GRADE_TYPE IS NOT NULL
  AND (
        cc.GRADE_TYPE IN ('LETTER','L','A-F')
        OR (cc.GRADE_TYPE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND cc.GRADE_TYPE_DESC LIKE '%Letter%')
      )
  AND su.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  COALESCE(cc.SCHOOL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME),
  p.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER_ASSEMBLED
ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME

     WHERE frs2.DEPT_CODE = COALESCE(ssea.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sols.OFFER_DEPT_CODE)

WITH lib_offerings AS (

    `SUBJECT_ID` AS lib_subject_id,
    `SUBJECT_TITLE` AS lib_subject_title,

  FROM library_subject_offered
  WHERE `TERM_CODE` LIKE '%2019%'

rows.question: For each department that is degree-granting, has a department budget code above 100000, and is not the Political Science department, give the department code, department name, school name, the number of unique courses offered by the department, the total number of units for all those courses, and the number of unique subject codes associated with those courses. Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH degree_granting_departments_filtered AS (
  SELECT
    sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME,
    sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE AS DEPT_BUDGET_CODE
  FROM sis_department sd
  WHERE
    (
      sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING IN ('Y','YES','1')
      OR sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 1
      OR sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'T'
    )
    -- keep rows where DEPT_BUDGET_CODE looks numeric so CAST is safe
    AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
)
SELECT
  d.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  -- count distinct course identifiers (use SUBJECT_ID if that represents the course unique id;
  -- fallback to SUBJECT_CODE+SUBJECT_NUMBER if SUBJECT_ID may not be present)
  COUNT(DISTINCT
    COALESCE(cc.SUBJECT_ID, CONCAT(cc.SUBJECT_CODE, '-', cc.SUBJECT_NUMBER))
  ) AS UNIQUE_COURSE_COUNT,
  -- sum of units across those courses (use TOTAL_UNITS column from course_catalog_subject_offered)
  SUM(IFNULL(cc.TOTAL_UNITS, 0)) AS TOTAL_UNITS,
  -- count distinct subject codes associated with those courses
  COUNT(DISTINCT cc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS UNIQUE_SUBJECT_CODE_COUNT
FROM degree_granting_departments_filtered d
LEFT JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered cc
  ON cc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science'
  AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17'
  AND CAST(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE AS UNSIGNED) > 100000
GROUP BY
  d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME
ORDER BY
  UNIQUE_COURSE_COUNT DESC

  -- prefer section-level enrollment if present, else fall back to subject-level aggregate if available
  COALESCE(sol.`SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER`, sol.`SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER`, sse.`total_subject_enrollment_number`) AS `NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS`,
  sol.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`,
  sol.`MEET_PLACE`
FROM
  subject_offered_latest_by_section AS sol
LEFT JOIN
  subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject AS sse
  ON sol.`TERM_CODE` = sse.`TERM_CODE`
  AND sol.`SUBJECT_ID` = sse.`SUBJECT_ID`
/* Note: literals (filters) should be applied by consumers of this view. */
)
SELECT
  `OFFER_DEPT_NAME` AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
  AVG(subject_enrollment_range) AS AVG_SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_RANGE
FROM subject_enrollment_range_by_subject sers
WHERE sers.`OFFER_DEPT_NAME` IN ('Chemistry','Biology')
  AND (
